name: multi-agent-kit
description: Guidance on splitting work between agents, plus hooks for tuios users: list tuios windows, close finished ones (dry-run until switched on). Each hook does nothing when its tool is missing.

tuios_session.title: tuios session
tuios_session.description: Name of the one tuios session the status line and the window reaper work in. Empty: both do nothing.

reaper_dry_run.title: Window reaper: dry-run
reaper_dry_run.description: On: log the tuios windows it would close and close nothing. Off: close them.

reaper_idle_minutes.title: Window reaper: idle minutes
reaper_idle_minutes.description: A window whose screen has not changed for this long, with no agent working in it, is closed.

herdr_tab_label.title: Window reaper: herdr tab to close
herdr_tab_label.description: Label of a herdr tab to close once the tuios session has no windows left. Empty: no tab is closed.
